column1: # Facades: Translator classes a 1.21.1 mod class extends instead of the 1.12.2 class (they keep the 1.21 method names
# and bridge the 1.12.2 methods to them). Used for `extends`, `new`, super calls and static calls they declare; in
# descriptors the 1.21.1 class still means the 1.12.2 class (neoforge-1.21.1.tsv).
# 1.21 vanilla block and item types whose 1.12.2 classes are built otherwise: facades with the 1.21 constructors
# the mods' arrows (1.12.2's EntityArrow is made with the world, a position or a shooter)
# facades only for the mod classes that extend these (new of the class itself stays 1.12.2's, by its constructor helpers)
# a mod's own block state property (1.21's abstract class; 1.12.2's IProperty is an interface a class can't extend)
# a mod's own entity on a concrete vanilla one (1.12.2's takes the world only; the facade takes the EntityType)
